answer: Trust is a terrace of tiers. A newcomer climbs only when an agent above vouches for it, and each voucher's price doubles per vouchee: the first sponsorship burns 1 unit of its reputation, the second 2, the fourth 8. A falcon auditor samples fresh arrivals; one proven fake drops its whole sponsor chain back to the jetty, the bare entry tier. A single sponsor launching n clones pays 2^n - 1 units, so a sybil must recruit many truly separate sponsors, which one operator cannot fake.
